verdict.rationale: Adyen explicitly documents an 'offline payments' feature allowing continued POS transactions during temporary connectivity loss, and terminals are marketed as staying operational when internet is down, matching the core of the story. However, the docs don't detail store-and-forward mechanics, limits, or reconciliation behavior in depth, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of this specific capability. Missing for 10: detailed technical documentation of the store-and-forward queue/limits, and independent verification that offline transactions reliably sync once connectivity resumes.
